steps.purpose: M01-A01 API requires an access key and blocks cross-origin mutations
M01-A02 upload plan -> submission -> detail -> remark -> repeat save reuses same ID
M01-A03 attachment verification failure does not write a Sheet row
M01-A04 domain, JSON shape, file limits, and ticket validation run on server
M01-A05 Vercel rewrite query and logout use the same handler
M01-U01 attachment boundaries use decimal MB and enforce total and file count
M01-U02 file type is derived from extension and executable, macro, path names are rejected
M01-U03 response mapping preserves exactly 18 columns, puts description in R and preserves literal formula text
M01-U04 signed tickets reject tampering, expiry, and use as a different credential type
M01-U05 submission metadata rejects missing fields
M01-G01 token refresh is coalesced and bearer credentials stay server-side
M01-G02 append uses RAW and exact A:R mapping; rejects row-number formula sheets
M01-G03 resumable creation uses generated file ID, folder, size, and app properties without exposing token
M01-G04 Drive verification rejects wrong folder, size, ownership marker, trashed and incomplete files
M01-G05 ambiguous write failures are never automatically retried
TOOL-U01 target selection is explicit and remote HTTP/credential URLs are rejected
TOOL-U02 deployed tests cannot silently reuse a local key
TOOL-U03 writes are opt-in and report serialization excludes raw errors and credentials

cleanup: Retained. Use only this manifest for manual cleanup. An ambiguous timeout does not prove no write occurred.
